rawText: About the standard The children's toy standard: requires that all toys that are intended or suitable for use by children 3 years and under do not have small parts that can be pulled apart from or break off the toy establishes an acceptable size — approximately the size of a ping pong ball — for toys for children 3 years and under, and sets up a range of tests that the product must be able to pass (such as a bite test and drop test) without small parts breaking off. More information Children's toys – Commerce Commission Te Komihana Tauhokohoko (external link)
